user.title: Add Metz Remote
user.description: Enter the TV address and optionally its MAC address for Wake-on-LAN. If Home Assistant runs in Docker, you may need to specify your LAN broadcast address.

data_description.f1_source_selection_button_id: Number printed on the remote button pressed after F1 to open the source list (0–9). The integration converts it to the correct SOAP key code. Leave blank to disable source selection.
data_description.power_sensor_entity_id: Watt sensor used for power state detection. Leave blank to use ICMP ping and toggle power.
